items.d:
The S.H.A.F.T. is part of the Arc-01 project.
It focuses energy and projects it to H.A.M.H.R.R., manipulating enough energy to operate multiple nomadic cities at the same time.
items.d2: Kristen pointed it at the sky. Who should we point it at?

items.d:
The H.A.M.H.R.R. is part of the Arc-01 project.
It receives energy from the ground and fires it at the target, able to reach a range beyond most Terrans' reckoning.
items.d2: Conquering the sky is the first step on the journey towards the stars, a journey we have embarked on.

items.d:
Designed by Kristen Wright based on her personal tastes.
The central planetarium is made with the finest cutting-edge technology, but the trajectories of the stars seem unfamiliar to Terrans.
items.d2: We have longed for the stars for thousands of years. Now it is time to reach out.

items.d:
A mountain of cubes, and an ice-cold cemetery.
What happened here is beyond our understanding.
items.d2: Someday, we will discover the secret of the cemetery. Perhaps it will no longer matter then.

note: Each area reads differently when you first arrive and once you're done.
